project.name: AIPI-Team
project.state: existing active project; one organization, workspace, repository binding and Auth user before isolated tests

deployment.result: applied and verified in remote migration history

assertions: January 31 three-calendar-month trial clamps to April 30
authenticated graph table reads and direct graph write RPCs have no grants
workspace editor write succeeds before membership revocation
workspace editor write fails after revocation without leaving a task row

twoUserApi.result: passed with two temporary signed-in Auth users and one isolated organization
observations: server-created workspace trial has activation and three-calendar-month end derived from workspace creation
viewer reads task, workspace, trial and snapshot before revocation
direct authenticated graph REST read is denied
viewer reads zero task, workspace and trial rows after workspace membership revocation
snapshot omits the revoked workspace after revocation
revoked viewer task REST write is denied
viewer receives a team_change_events websocket event after Postgres subscription readiness while authorized
the event written after viewer revocation is absent from the same websocket during a four-second observation window
editing the isolated workspace does not change its trial activation/end dates
a service-owned fixture expiry blocks new Team change events while preserving owner task and trial reads
a fresh owner sign-in after fixture expiry retains the expired trial dates

export.sourceChange: The Team worker export now includes workspace subscription dates and rejects incomplete subscription coverage.
export.sourceValidation: Cloud worker smoke passed with an expired-trial fixture and authorized repository access; missing subscription data returns conflict instead of a partial export.
export.deployedWorkerAttempt: GET https://mcp.aipi.website/api/team/organizations/{isolatedOrg}/export returned HTTP 403 with no JSON error through this host. A separate unauthenticated curl to the same host timed out. The cause was not established; the isolated fixture was removed.

validation.rootNpmTest: passed before the final worker export edit
validation.tokenPersistence: Management token and project keys were read through process stdin or memory and were not written to repository files.

limitations: The existing project was not a fresh disposable Supabase project; its existing organization, workspace, binding and user were not used as fixtures.
This does not cover a second physical device, offline/out-of-order sync, current GitHub user/App-scope revocation, worker artifact routes, or live private Storage artifact access.
The project has only a public logo Storage bucket; no private Team artifact bucket was available to exercise artifact revocation.
Realtime revocation was observed for four seconds on one subscribed channel, not across reconnects or all event routes. The repeatable websocket probe is scripts/live-supabase-realtime-probe.mjs.

Trial expiry was simulated by changing the isolated fixture's end timestamp; a real three-month elapsed lifecycle and paid conversion were not checked. Deployed post-expiry export remains unproven after an unexplained 403 from this host.
D0, D1, D5 and all later delivery-stage gates remain open.
